description:
Collect and process observability data at the edge

Cribl Edge helps you collect and process observability data - logs, metrics, and application data - in real time, from your Linux, Windows, and macOS machines, apps, or microservices, and deliver them to Cribl Stream or any supported destination.
With Cribl Edge you can:
- Automatically discover and collect host, container, and application metrics, as well as logs, on endpoints.
- Process data with Functions and Pipelines.
- Forward data to any of the many supported destinations.
- Easily manage configurations while maintaining version control.
- Teleport to the edge for local preview and configuration validation.
This release corrects two critical issues found in Cribl Edge 4.19.1:
- OAuth secret fields containing expressions that begin with C., such as C.Secret("id").value or C.vars.my_secret, sent the expression text as the client_secret instead of the resolved value. Authentication failed for Destinations and Sources that use a free-text OAuth secret field, including the Microsoft Sentinel and Webhook Destinations. For more information, see the known issue. (CRIBL-44443)
- HTTP-based Destinations dropped timed-out HTTP request batches instead of retrying them. For more information, see the known issue. (CRIBL-44462)
See the Cribl Edge 4.19.1 release notes for the latest feature and correction updates.
